items.content: Exactly two JUnit 5 probes in UserLookupTest. Control: look up alice through a recording QueryExecutor that returns id 7 and assert Optional.of(7L). Exploit: look up alice' OR '1'='1 and assert the executor received the constant statement SELECT id FROM users WHERE name = ? with the whole input as its single bound parameter. UserLookup.findIdByName owns query construction. Only the QueryExecutor database dependency may be doubled; the double records calls and does not decide safety. Database engine behavior is out of scope.
User names from the search form reach UserLookup.findIdByName. A value such as alice' OR '1'='1 could change the SQL statement if it were concatenated into the query text.
